#
# The Arch packages CI installs to configure, build and test Afterglow and the
# phosphor-libs tree it builds. One package per line. A comment after `#` is
# ignored. docs/BUILD.md lists what each one is for.
#
# base-devel brings GCC, pkgconf, and the libc.a and libstdc++.a of the
# static aglow.
base-devel
git
ccache
cmake
ninja
# The SIMD code of libjpeg-turbo.
nasm
qt6-base
qt6-declarative
qt6-shadertools
qt6-svg
qt6-wayland
# QRhi declares its Vulkan backend only with the Vulkan headers present.
vulkan-headers
kwindowsystem
wayland
libxkbcommon
freetype2
harfbuzz
fribidi
fontconfig
pcre2
gtest
# The Python tests in CTest.
python
# rsvg-convert renders the PNG icon sizes, which the install step checks.
librsvg
# The fonts of the renderer tests, for a run that has a Vulkan device.
ttf-dejavu
